blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Sugar is measured in tonnes and kilos. One tonne is one thousand kilos. It is a big unit.

In international trade, we usually count in tonnes. Sometimes we write MT. MT means metric tonnes. It is the same thing.

Today we learn five words. We also learn how to use two small words: per and of. We say "the price is 400 dollars per tonne" and "twenty tonnes of sugar". Small units, big business.

items.q: How many kilos are in one tonne?
items.why: "One tonne is one thousand kilos."

items.q: What does MT mean?
items.why: "MT means metric tonnes."

items.q: In international trade, we usually count in…
items.why: "In international trade, we usually count in tonnes."

items.q: The text says a tonne is "a big unit". This suggests that…
options: a tonne is smaller than a kilo
a tonne holds a lot of weight
a kilo is heavier than a tonne
items.why: Inferência: uma tonelada = 1.000 kilos, então é muito peso — uma unidade grande.

items.q: The author would most likely AGREE that…
options: we can write tonnes as MT and mean the same thing
sugar is never measured in kilos
per and of are not useful words
tonnes and MT are two different weights
items.why: Inferência: "Sometimes we write MT… It is the same thing."

blocks.instruction: Ouça Ethan explicando como o açúcar é embalado. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi, I am Ethan. Let me show you how we pack the sugar.

First, the sugar goes into bags. Each bag is fifty kilos. So twenty bags make one tonne. That is easy to remember: twenty bags, one tonne.

Then we put the bags inside a container. A big container holds many bags. It can carry about twenty-five tonnes of sugar. The bags go in, and we close the door.

After that, the containers go on a ship. Each ship carries many containers. We ship the sugar by the tonne, not by the bag. Today we are loading ten thousand tonnes.

The price is four hundred dollars per tonne. Per tonne means for each tonne. So we always talk about tonnes when we talk about money. Small bags, big numbers. That is the sugar business.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: How heavy is each bag?
items.why: "Each bag is fifty kilos."

items.q: How many bags make one tonne?
items.why: "twenty bags make one tonne."

items.q: How much sugar can a big container carry?
items.why: "It can carry about twenty-five tonnes of sugar."

items.q: Ethan says "per tonne means for each tonne". This suggests that the price is counted…
items.why: Inferência: "per" indica o preço para cada unidade — cada tonelada.

items.q: Why does Ethan say "small bags, big numbers"?
options: Because many small bags add up to a lot of tonnes
Because one bag is very heavy
items.why: Inferência: sacas de 50 kg somam milhares de toneladas — pequeno vira grande.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "We shipped ten thousand tonnes of sugar." A tonne is…
items.why: Tonne = tonelada = 1.000 kilos.

items.q: "Each bag is fifty kilos." A kilo is…
items.why: Kilo = quilo, uma unidade de peso.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "We put the sugar into a fifty-kilo ___."
items.why: Bag = saca/saco; é onde o açúcar vai antes de ir no contêiner.

items.q: "The bags go inside a big container." A container is…
items.why: Container = contêiner, a caixa grande usada para transportar as sacas.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "The price is four hundred dollars ___ tonne."
items.why: Per = por (unidade): 400 dólares por tonelada.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que aparecem quando falamos de embalar e enviar açúcar. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "We load the bags into the container." To load means to…
items.why: Load = carregar, colocar as coisas dentro.

items.q: "We ship the sugar by the tonne." To ship means to…
items.why: Ship = enviar (por navio).

items.q: "How much does one bag weigh?" To weigh asks about…
items.why: Weigh = pesar; a pergunta é sobre o peso.

items.q: "Twenty bags add up to one tonne." To add up to means to…
items.why: Add up to = somar, dar um total de.

items.q: "The container is full, so we close it up." To close it up means to…
items.why: Close it up = fechar por completo.
